Author: Serpens66
Name: Custom Custom Trail
Description: Creates portable Coop Trails in the Trail Maker, synchronizes the selected package, and coordinates Custom Trail mod settings.

Changes: Add an upload-page option for including Custom Trail mod-settings sidecars while preserving an explicit Vanilla-only upload path.
Add the shared Mod Settings search with title, optional tooltip and section filtering, safe global-search handoff, and automatic text-field focus.
Restore backward-compatible loading of primitive Boolean and integer values when a Trail setting has migrated to an enum with a MessagePack formatter.
Generate Portable PDB debug symbols for Unity Mono-compatible stack traces and debugging.
Scopes per-player identity diagnostics to the authenticated sender and includes the finalized Script Extender synchronization workaround.
Waits for Vanilla's authoritative lobby slots when synchronizing personal Coop readiness and includes the extended shared per-player transport workaround.
Fixed Coop readiness checks to use the shared authoritative lobby roster and block launch when player identities are incomplete or contradictory.
fix game localization
Tooltip size test.
Places the separate host and local-client activation switches visibly beside their corresponding settings headings.
Keeps the selected Trail mod-settings preset active on clients across a host-triggered Coop map launch by synchronizing an authenticated launch transition.
Recognizes normal Coop lobby members as human participants so matching ready package states no longer produce an empty participant audit.
Synchronizes the Coop Trail Customize transition from the host to clients through an authenticated, explicitly formatted lobby packet.
Avoids constructing Vanilla's MainViewModel during early package initialization, preventing a selected Coop package from aborting Custom Custom Trail startup before its mission hooks are installed.
Refreshes the visible Coop mission as soon as synchronized host package settings arrive, so clients no longer retain the previously selected Vanilla map.
Publishes the client's validated package status after synchronized host settings have finished applying, preventing a matching installed package from remaining falsely unreported.
Resolves participant status through the same Steam-ID-to-player-slot mapping as SyncPerPlayer and reports missing, differing, and still-unreported packages separately to the host.
Defers subscribed Steam Workshop package discovery until Steamworks is initialized and refreshes it from the existing Coop UI entry points.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Standardizes Mod Settings with shared presets and separate local-client and synchronized host activation controls.
Applies the shared large, long-duration modsettings tooltip design explicitly to dynamically generated mod-selection checkboxes.
Supports an explicit dependency-free plugin opt-out marker that removes a mod completely from Trail settings discovery, compatibility lists, logging, capture, and application.
Moves the active custom Coop Trail host dropdown directly below the general mod description and above the per-mod Trail capture checkboxes.
Validates each dynamic mod integration including its complete disabled MessagePack snapshot before offering it for Trail capture.
Rejects duplicate settings panels sharing one plugin GUID and logs concrete compatibility failures without cluttering the in-game name list.
Excludes DoNotPersist properties from the shared preset system and limits mission-preset exit calls to mods actually entered by CustomCustomTrail.
Updates the compatibility guide and README to document the dynamic unmanaged-by-default fallback accurately.
Discovers compatible third-party lobby-settings mods dynamically and lets Trail authors include or omit each mod through locally persisted checkboxes.
Lists installed incompatible modsettings panels separately and links a public compatibility guide for mod authors.
Treats absent Trail mod entries as unmanaged, preserving their current settings instead of disabling them.
Shows an automatically generated list of the installed supported mods whose host settings Custom Trails save and restore.
Removes superseded title timing, translation-source, Visual Tree, and diagnostic paths while retaining the verified Noesis Logical Tree solution.
Finds the unnameable inner Coop Trail heading through Noesis' logical tree and detaches its stale Vanilla translation binding.
Prevents Coop title diagnostics from constructing MainViewModel during early startup, so package activation and cleanup cannot be interrupted.
Keeps inner Coop Trail names correct on first visibility by updating their bound translation sources and adds targeted Trail-versus-mission title diagnostics.
Updates each inner Coop Trail title deterministically as soon as Vanilla finishes constructing that page, including the first visit.
Defers the inner Coop Trail page-title refresh until Noesis has actually created the page on its first visit.
Discovers subscribed Coop Trail packages directly in their read-only Steam Workshop install folders and exposes their editable sources through the safe Vanilla Trail Maker import path.
Merges byte-identical local and Workshop replicas of one package while continuing to reject conflicting duplicate package IDs.
Refreshes the selected Coop Trail page after Vanilla creates it so the custom package name appears on the first visit without opening mod settings.
Lists portable Coop Trails in the map editor's Steam Workshop Trail uploader and uploads their complete package while preserving Vanilla's normal Custom Trail path.
Defers discovery of Coop selection-menu buttons until Vanilla has created FrontendMenus, preventing early MainViewModel construction from disabling the package catalog.
Shows the selected custom Coop package name on every occupied entry in the four-Trail Coop selection menu and restores Vanilla names for unoccupied entries.

Retains Coop mission mod settings through Vanilla's direct COOP_START transition, restores the normal Play control after Customize, and displays a localized reason whenever package validation blocks a start.
Applies the shared Trail mission preset for direct Coop launches and editable Coop setup, resolves the exact parameterless host-update method, and retains settings across the launch map transition.
Stores future complex SyncHostOnly mission settings through the same typed MessagePack serialization used by the shared preset system while retaining compatibility with existing JSON values.
Shows existing Coop packages in Vanilla's Trail export list and supports synchronized numeric-array settings in mission mod-settings snapshots.
Uses the same synchronously captured mission mod-settings snapshot for normal and Coop exports, including exports nested inside Vanilla's mission-save call.
Shows Coop packages with nested TrailMakerSource files in Vanilla's in-game Trail import list while retaining Vanilla's backup, clear and import workflow.
Routes nested Coop Trail Maker sources through Vanilla's original non-overwriting import method and preserves existing mod-settings sidecars.
Stores editable Trail Maker sources in a nested folder so Coop exports no longer appear as normal Custom Trails.
Reapplies the embedded Trail mod-settings preset after the Coop Customize setup screen has finished rebuilding.
Initialized the Coop package dropdown with Vanilla and stabilized SelectedItem updates so package changes no longer require a second selection attempt.
Replaced the unavailable Unity DataContract JSON serializer with the mod's dependency-free JSON codec so Coop Trail packages can be exported and loaded in-game.
Placed the Trail Maker's Coop Trail option directly beside the Vanilla Backup option so both remain fully visible in the export dialog.
Shows each exported map name as the selected Coop mission title and uses the active package name for every occupied Coop Trail heading.
Added an in-game Coop Trail export option that converts the first 40 Trail Maker missions into one portable package for all four Coop Trails.
Added a host-controlled package dropdown with SHA-256 content verification and Ready/Play blocking for missing or differing participant packages.
Bundled custom maps, lords and AIVs automatically and embedded each mission's host-controlled mod settings.
Replaced the legacy plugin-local CoopTrails/TrailN layout with selectable cooptrail.json packages stored beside normal Custom Trails.
Added a player-facing explanation below the activation setting describing Custom Trail settings, customization, local Coop replacements and disabled behavior.
Added a locally persisted activation setting that disables Custom Trail sidecars, customization integration and Coop mission replacements without removing the mod files.
Restored replaced Vanilla Coop mission slots immediately when the mod is disabled and hid the injected Coop Customize buttons.
Added schema migration for Trail mod settings: missing current settings use their ViewModel defaults, while removed settings are ignored and omitted on the next sidecar save.
Applied the same schema cleanup when loading embedded coopmission.json modSettings blocks.
Suppressed transient Custom Trail selection callbacks while opening the Customize lobby so they cannot replace the selected mission preset.
Added sidecar path, existence and enabled-mod diagnostics to Trail load logs.
Captured the currently visible Trail settings synchronously for each individual save instead of carrying an unload snapshot into the next save.
Added an enabled-mod summary to each Trail sidecar capture log entry.
Preserved editable Trail mod settings before the Trail Maker unloads its map during saving.
Prevented capture failures from overwriting sidecars with an all-disabled fallback.
Centralized all Custom Trail sidecar, mission-preset and customization hooks in CustomCustomTrail.
Removed per-settings-mod hook leaders and the Coop reflection bridge.
Added the shared Customize button to all four Coop lobby pages.
Changed missions to schema 2 with canonical seven-mod modSettings and neutral Shared Trail-preset integration.
Removed the top-level startConditions bridge and built-in fallback runtime.
Removed lobby hash verification; missions are mapped only by TrailN/NN.coopmission.json and remain directly editable.
Added slot-based Coop mission replacement with maps, custom lords and ordered AIV lists.
Added SHA-256 lobby verification and shared Start Conditions integration.
